**PRIOR AUTHORIZATION DETERMINATION**

**Decision: DENY**

**Service:** Continuous Glucose Monitor (CGM)  
**Order Date:** May 23, 2025

---

**DETERMINATION:**

Your request for continuous glucose monitoring has been reviewed against medical necessity criteria. While the patient meets criteria for diagnosis and clinical need, the authorization cannot be approved due to missing documentation.

**CRITERIA ANALYSIS:**

**Diagnosis – MET**  
Type 2 diabetes mellitus with hyperglycemia (E11.65) documented since 2013; patient currently managed with metformin.

**Clinical Need – MET**  
Patient has recurrent Level 2 hypoglycemic events (glucose <54 mg/dL) persisting despite medication adjustments:
- Glucose 48 mg/dL (8/19/2024)
- Glucose 48 mg/dL (8/20/2024)  
- Glucose 43 mg/dL (10/20/2024)

Two documented medication adjustments made (glipizide dose reduction in March 2024; discontinued and replaced with sitagliptin in May 2024), yet hypoglycemic episodes continue.

**Recent Diabetes Evaluation – NOT MET**  
No in-person visit documenting diabetes control evaluation occurred within 6 months prior to the order date. The most recent qualifying visit was 9/7/2024 (258 days before order). Subsequent encounters (10/28/2024 annual wellness; 1/12/2025 vital signs only) do not document diabetes control assessment.

**REQUIRED TO PROCEED:**

Submit documentation of an in-person visit with diabetes control evaluation completed within 6 months of the order date (on or after 11/23/2024).
